title: v05 walk sprites NPC02-NPC10 frame review
reviewer: Claude Code session (internal frame review on the imported originals; not a producer approval)
material: asset-source/v05_frames (1,296 original PNGs, integrity PASS per V05_VERIFY_REPORT.json), BG02 composite at 720x1280, engine shadows from walk_clips.json
method: contact sheets frame_qa/<NPC>_sheet.jpg (3 views x frames 0,4,..,44,47) for all 9
feet sheets frame_qa/<NPC>_feet.jpg (all 48 frames per view)
side upper-body sheets frame_qa/<NPC>_arm_side.jpg (every 2nd frame): looked at for NPC02, NPC03, NPC09, NPC10; NPC04-08 only at 4-frame steps in the contact sheet
seam sheets frame_qa/<NPC>_seam.jpg (enter front 47 vs exit rear 0)
status_rule: PASS only when every criterion below is PASS for that NPC and view. Any art or motion defect = REVISE. A defect that the existing frames cannot fix without re-rendering the source path = BLOCKED. Integrity PASS is not quality PASS.

criteria.alternation: left/right feet alternate (heel strikes from the rig, shoe drawn on the floor at those frames)
criteria.planted_foot: a flat resting shoe does not move in the image (shoe-region centroid, consecutive flat frames)
criteria.joints: knee, ankle and shoulder joins read as one limb
criteria.arms: arm swing, and the far arm hidden or shaded behind the body
criteria.consistency: face, head size and build stay the same through the clip
criteria.perspective: size and depth match the background camera (BG02)
criteria.contact: sole on the floor row the rig predicts, contact shadow under the shoe
criteria.sequence: position and pose continue from enter (front) through idle to exit (rear)

LEG_STRIP.frames: measured: rig near/far leg image length > 1.15 (see production_requests_v05.json)
LEG_STRIP.problem: The leg nearer the camera is a flat texture strip stretched along the projected hip-heel line (up to 1.72x the far leg, NPC03 front 46). No foreshortening, and the shin strip sits on the thigh with a blurred band at the knee, so it reads as a long stovepipe leg.
LEG_STRIP.fix: Redraw the near leg for frames toward the camera with foreshortening (knee overlap, shorter visible shin, trouser folds), or render legs from a volume model; remove the knee band. Re-export the affected front/rear frames on the same 720x1280 canvas and path.

KNEE_CROUCH.frames: measured: stance (flat foot) knee flexion > 25 deg
KNEE_CROUCH.problem: Knee stays bent while the foot is flat on the floor: up to 44.4 deg on walk_rig_scene_retimed_v01 and 42.9 deg on walk_rig_elder_v04. Reads as a crouched walk.
KNEE_CROUCH.fix: Retime the rig so the stance knee straightens to about 5-20 deg after loading (elder rig may stay a little more bent if that is the design intent, stated in the rig). Re-render side, front and rear from the corrected rig.

TORSO_STATIC.problem: The torso is one texture with at most about 1 deg roll (render.js sin(frame)*0.018 rad). No shoulder/pelvis counter-rotation, small arm swing; the figure glides.
TORSO_STATIC.fix: Add shoulder and pelvis counter-rotation (shoulder line and hip line visibly opposite over the cycle) and a matching arm swing; keep the face texture unchanged.

FAR_ARM.problem: The far arm shows behind the back as a thin flat strip. NPC03: bare skin strip without the rolled grey sleeve the near arm has. NPC09: thin dark strip with a white cuff, no shading.
FAR_ARM.fix: Draw the far arm with the same sleeve as the near arm, darker (it is in the body's shadow) and mostly hidden behind the torso; never as a flat strip.

ARM_LONG.problem: The bare near arm is drawn very long and thin in the forward swing; the hand reaches below the hip.
ARM_LONG.fix: Correct the arm segment lengths / wrist fraction for NPC10 (config arm_wrist_fraction) and redraw the bare forearm with volume.

CARRY_STATIC.problem: The carrying arm (NPC03 parcel, NPC09 folder) is one fixed bent-arm drawing hung on the left shoulder; elbow and wrist never move, the prop does not react to the steps.
CARRY_STATIC.fix: Small secondary motion of elbow and wrist (a few degrees, in step with the stride) and a slight prop bounce; keep the sleeve texture continuous with the shoulder.

NO_TURN_IDLE.problem: Enter ends mid-stride facing the camera and exit starts mid-stride facing away. There is no idle (standing) art and no turn frames, so the figure has to hold a mid-step pose while waiting and then pops 180 deg. The lowest silhouette row jumps 101-150 px and the body scale 0-10 % (NPC06 28 %).
NO_TURN_IDLE.fix: Per NPC: an in-place idle loop (no root motion) that starts from enter frame 47, and an in-place turn (front -> rear) that ends on exit frame 0, on the same canvas and camera.

PATH_GAP.problem: render.js line 50 places every clip on fixed paths: front z = 2.92 - p0, rear z = 1.8 + p0. The elder rig walks 0.587 m in 47 frames (0.34 m/s), so enter ends at z 2.333 m while exit starts at z 1.8 m: 0.533 m at the root, 0.437 m measured from the lowest silhouette row (the 0.44 m reported before), head width +28.1 % in the images.
PATH_GAP.fix: Start the rear path where the enter clip ends: rear z = (2.92 - root_x(47) * S) + p0 for walk_rig_elder_v04 (2.333 m), or derive both path constants from the rig travel for every NPC. Re-render NPC06 rear (exit) frames. The engine must not stretch or shift the frames to hide it.

NPC06.sequence: PATH_GAP needs a re-render of the exit path; no engine-side fix without moving or scaling the figure

passed_by_measurement: alternation, planted_foot, consistency, perspective (BG02), contact: see frame_metrics_v05.json. These do not make a view PASS on their own.
